---
title: "Stage 4 — Species table"
output: html_document
params:
  config_file: "config/madagascar.yml"
  mode: "figure"                 # figure | build
  verbose: false
  iucn_mode: "cache_or_query"    # cache_only | cache_or_query | refresh
  iucn_pause_seconds: 2
---

```{r run, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
source(file.path("R", "stage4_workflow.R"))
rmd_options <- project_rmd_params("4_build_species_table.Rmd")
configured <- rmd_project_config(rmd_options, "stage4")
rmd_params <- configured$params
context <- application_rmd_stage4_context(rmd_params)
prepared <- if (identical(rmd_params$mode, "build")) {
  prepare_application_rmd_stage4(context)
} else list(frozen_inputs = NULL)
frozen <- prepared$frozen_inputs
config <- stage4_application_config(
  rmd_params, context, frozen_inputs = frozen,
  iucn_mode = if (is.null(frozen)) rmd_params$iucn_mode else "cache_only"
)
describe_stage4_config(config)
stage4_result <- run_stage4(config)
if (identical(rmd_params$mode, "build")) {
  if (is.null(frozen)) {
    frozen <- write_application_inputs(context, stage4_result$habitat_rows)
  }
  application_commit_boundary(
    context, application_stage4_boundary(stage4_result, context)
  )
}
```

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
if (!is.null(stage4_result$class_counts)) {
  print(knitr::kable(stage4_result$class_counts, row.names = FALSE))
}
cat("Action:", stage4_result$action, "\n")
cat("Rows:", stage4_result$rows, "\n")
cat("Elapsed seconds:", sprintf("%.1f", stage4_result$elapsed_seconds), "\n")
if (!is.null(stage4_result$figure) && file.exists(stage4_result$figure)) {
  print(knitr::include_graphics(stage4_result$figure))
}
```
